recap.paragraph: Who ruled the field in Cincinnati? The Bengals did, beating the Steelers 38-18! Joe Burrow tossed 4 touchdown passes, and Ja'Marr Chase snagged 231 yards. Chase Brown caught a touchdown pass, too. Aaron Rodgers fired touchdown passes to DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth in the fourth quarter. But the Bengals soared to their 5th straight win! They moved to 7-2 and took first place alone in the AFC North.
